Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect normalization rule that forced any “Palos Verdes” mention (including “Palos Verdes Estates”) to be converted to “Rancho Palos Verdes, CA,” and suggested using burial location as corroboration for death place. This would misstate the verified location from the Los Angeles Times obituary (“Palos Verdes Estates”) and could lead to an incorrect final answer by conflating distinct municipalities on the Palos Verdes Peninsula.
